prospective_draft_integrity.warning: The hidden candidate is an unreviewed local draft, not sealed Gold; it is absent from a clean clone. Its hash records local integrity only, not clinical correctness or future leakage resistance.

allocation_rules: Author prospective families after split registration; do not relabel any currently public family as hidden.
Place both language variants, paraphrases, sibling vignettes and adaptations of one source article in the same split.
For calibration, obtain independent clinician ratings and bilingual review before using cases to tune judges.

For hidden Gold, keep prompts and keys outside the public repository with access logs and sealed hashes; public case reports can inform domain coverage but should not be copied as recognizable hidden vignettes.
Do not publish per-stratum model comparisons until a statistician sets uncertainty and minimum-sample rules.
Professional documentation strata require a new validated contract before allocation; reserve rather than silently reassign those slots.
